name: shoulders
note: Road shoulders + width tapers along Sukhumvit Road (pilot) - tools/mapgen/road_shoulders.py, docs/ROAD_SHOULDERS.md. Flat road-height strips along slab edges that drop straight to the terrain (road top 1.0, terrain -2), taper fills where the carriageway narrows abruptly, and fills for small holes inside the carriageway. Optional terrain fill boxes (Terrain:FillBlock) beside the shoulders. Distances in map-local studs; world = map + origin_world.

names: ถนนสุขุมวิท
targets.note: an edge is a target when its Studio name is in names AND its class in classes (the trunk), or its class is a near_classes key and it lies within that many studs of a target trunk edge (the slip roads / underpass links). bboxes_world [[x0, z0, x1, z1], ...] limits the targets to those boxes (empty = everywhere).

shoulder.name: Shoulder
shoulder.note: top 1.5 cm under the road top (1.00) and 0.5 cm under the junction / joint discs (0.99), above the aprons (0.98): flush for a wheel, no z-fighting where a piece tucks under a slab edge

terrain.note: optional: Terrain:FillBlock boxes outside the shoulder (from the shoulder edge outwards, width studs), only where the whole slice is clear of every road / sidewalk / apron / corner fill / building (+2) / prop (+1). The box fills half of the voxel layer y -4 .. 0 (top -2): PattayaBuilder.buildTerrain measured that a full layer up to grid line Y renders / collides at Y + 2 (ground filled to -4 shows at -2), so a FULL layer here would show at +2, above the road; half occupancy is expected to show near 0 (1 stud under the shoulder instead of 3) - not measured, PattayaShoulderBuilder.Probe reports the surface height per box. Built only by PattayaShoulderBuilder.BuildTerrain; the touched voxels are backed up first (TerrainRegion) so RemoveTerrain / Remove restore them.

drive.note: a wheel point is supported by any surface within contact_radius (a tyre is not a point: hairline seams under 0.05 studs, road_seams class micro, do not count as a drop)
